channel.title: Paksh: Sports
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: England coach warns Palmer and Mainoo over camp absences
item.description: England coach Thomas Tuchel has stated that Cole Palmer is "missing way too many camps." The comments were made in relation to absences from England training sessions. Kobbie Mainoo was also mentioned in relation to England absences. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: NHL Expands to 84-Game Season
item.description: The National Hockey League (NHL) is implementing an 84-game regular season for the first time in decades. This expansion marks a significant change to the league's schedule. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Late Brazil goal denies Socceroos victory after Irankunda stunner
item.description: Brazil scored in the final seconds of a match to equalize against the Socceroos, denying them a victory. Nestory Irankunda had given the Socceroos the lead with a "stunning" free kick. The match took place in Townsville. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Portugal is set to play Wales in the UEFA Nations League. Cristiano Ronaldo is participating in the match, with reports indicating he is aiming to reach 1,000 career goals before retirement. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Bob Pettit, a celebrated basketball player and the NBA's first Most Valuable Player, has passed away at the age of 93. He is widely recognized as a basketball great. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.description: Canada is scheduled to play a Nations League game in Toronto. Additionally, the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) has announced its first all-star game will take place in Toronto, a decision described as making "a lot of sense." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: In a squash tournament, Anahat Singh and Tanvi Khanna have advanced to set up an all-Indian quarterfinal match. Abhay Singh, Veer Chotrani, Joshna Chinappa, and Senthil Kumar have also progressed in their respective matches. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India's Football Team Plays Panama in FIFA Friendly
item.description: The Indian men's national football team commenced a FIFA friendly window by playing against Panama. This match is part of their preparation for upcoming games against Brazil and Uruguay, as they continue their run towards the World Cup. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: New York Yankees player Aaron Judge has been sidelined again due to a sore right calf. He received an injection for the injury and is unlikely to play in the wild card series. Reports suggest the team may regret skipping a rehab assignment… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: PWHL to Host Inaugural All-Star Event in Fourth Season
item.description: The Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) will hold its first All-Star event during its fourth season. The event is designed to showcase the league's top talent. It is scheduled to take place in Toronto. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: England coach says Spain's World Cup success is inimitable
item.description: England women's national football team coach, Sarina Wiegman, stated that Spain's World Cup-winning stars are 'built different' and their success cannot be imitated. She believes England cannot copy Spain's approach. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Peter V'landys has been appointed as the Australian Rugby League Commission (ARLC) executive chairman, a role he could hold for six years. The appointment was reported by SMH.com.au. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: In Round 7 of the Chess Olympiad, India's men's team defeated England 2.5-1.5, while the women's team beat Germany decisively, preserving India's chance to contest the gold medals. The men's side also faced Uzbekistan in a crucial tie for… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 11 · Right 4.

item.description: George Gillett Jr., aged 87, the former owner of the Montreal Canadiens and former Liverpool football club owner, died after a battle with Alzheimer’s disease. He had purchased the Bell Centre (then called the Molson Centre) and a majority… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Shohei Ohtani Activated by Dodgers from Injured List
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers have activated Shohei Ohtani from the 15-day injured list. Ohtani had been on the injured list due to injuries to his left knee and right biceps, and had also been experiencing neck soreness. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Veerendra Sehwag's son, Aryaveer, played cricket, batting alongside the captain. In a match against Australia, the Indian team achieved a clean sweep. One report noted Aryaveer's performance on a pitch where a century was previously… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.description: Cricketer Virat Kohli arrived in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, to a large reception ahead of the West Indies ODI series. He was met with a "hero's welcome" and a "red carpet" upon his arrival. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Presidents Cup Golf Tournament Set for Medinah in 2026
item.description: The 2026 Presidents Cup golf tournament is scheduled to take place at the Medinah Country Club in Bloomingdale, Illinois. The venue has undergone years of preparation for the event. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
